en.answer: In this case, you can Normal Summon once normally, once more by the effect of <<7219>>, and one additional time with the effect of <<11649>>, meaning a total of 3 Normal Summons are possible this turn.
en.question: If I activated <<7219>> this turn, and I control <<11649>>, what is the maximum number of times I can perform a Normal Summon this turn?
en.title: If I activated <<7219>> this turn, and I control <<11649>>, what is the maximum number of times I can perform a Normal Summon this turn?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、１ターンに１度行える通常召喚で１回、「<<7219>>」の効果による１回、「<<11649>>」の効果による1回、合計３回の召喚を行う事が可能です。
